title: Building HTTP Servers with Node.js
objectives: Build raw HTTP servers, handle routing, parse bodies, and serve static files.
theory_markdown: The `http` module creates servers. `createServer` returns a server instance. Routing parses `req.url` and `req.method`. Body parsing collects chunks from `req` stream. Static file serving reads from disk and pipes to response with correct MIME types.

code_walkthrough.explanation: `URL` parses query strings and pathnames. Route matching uses regex. `parseBody` collects chunks and parses JSON. CORS headers enable cross-origin requests. `OPTIONS` handles preflight requests.
